meta.name: update-skills
meta.description: Re-apply your installed skills to pull their latest code from upstream.

copy.tagline: 重新应用已安装的技能以拉取最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已安装多个技能并希望保持它们最新
copy.tagline_en: Re-apply installed skills to pull their latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have installed skills and want to keep them up-to-date

howto.what: Claude 会重新应用你已安装的技能,从上游拉取最新代码。它能列出可更新的技能,你勾选后逐个更新,完成后自动构建并测试,必要时重建容器镜像。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中运行 /update-skills 命令时触发。

say.text: 运行 /update-skills,把已安装的技能都更新一遍。
say.note: Claude 会先检查仓库状态,再列出可更新的技能供你勾选。

say.text: 在 /update-skills 里只选 Slack,其他跳过。
say.note: Claude 会只重跑 Slack 对应的技能。

say.text: 更新一下技能,但跳过有问题的那些。
say.note: Claude 会记录失败项并继续处理剩余技能。

howto.what_en: Claude will re-apply your installed skills to pull their latest code from upstream. It checks for a clean tree, lists updateable skills, lets you select which to re-apply, then validates with build and test, rebuilding the container image if needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run /update-skills in Claude Code.

say_en.text: Run /update-skills to update all installed skills.
say_en.note: Claude will check the repo and list updateable skills.

say_en.text: In /update-skills, select only Slack and skip the rest.
say_en.note: Claude will re-apply just the Slack skill.

say_en.text: Update skills but skip the problematic ones.
say_en.note: Claude will continue with remaining skills after recording failures.
